title: What to do right now.
blurb: Six techniques on two sides of a card. Three for the moment you're in, three for building a calmer baseline. Print it, keep it somewhere you'll find it at 3am.

card_face.name: The Physiological Sigh
steps: Two short breaths in through the nose.
One long breath out through the mouth.
